headline: Atomos Brand Monitoring Report for November 9, 2026

coverage.summary: DPReview has covered Atomos product updates and compatibility enhancements, including the Shinobi II's expanded touch-to-focus support and the Ninja V's planned ProRes RAW recording for Nikon cameras.

Blackmagic Design's ATEM Switchers 11.0.1 SDK and software updates, released on November 3, 2026, provide developer support for ATEM 11.0.1, allowing updates to hardware control and software interfaces for ATEM production switchers.

visibility_gaps: GPT retail/product sources are treated as unverified leads, not new verified social mentions.
methodology: This report includes findings from publicly available sources, focusing on Atomos brand developments and product updates as of November 9, 2026. All information is based on original articles and official announcements.
